newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Stadium Australia extends package offer.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Stadium Australia extends package offer.

text.p: Property developer Stadium Australia said on Monday it would extend the offer period for its gold and platinum packages to December 13 and that its underwriters were looking at a further extension to March 27.

"If the further extension is adopted, the marketing of Gold packages will target corporate investors, subject to SOCOG (Sydney Organising Committee for the Olympic Games) guidelines," Stadium Australia said.
Individuals would retain their priority for the gold packages if applications were submitted by December 13, it said.
Stadium Australia is trying to raise A$364.4 million to fund the construction of the main stadium for the Sydney 2000 Olympic Games.
